company.name: GoDefi
company.shortDescription: GoDefi is a Web3 fintech platform that provides a non-custodial decentralized finance (DeFi) payment system.
company.description: GoDefi is a Web3 fintech platform that provides a non-custodial decentralised finance (DeFi) payment system connecting cryptocurrency wallets to real-world payments. The platform enables users to link their personal crypto wallets and spend digital assets directly through a payment card without transferring funds to centralised intermediaries.

productsAndServices.description: A non-custodial payment card linked directly to a user's DeFi wallet on Solana, allowing payments without preloading funds.
productsAndServices.name: GoDefi Payment Card

productsAndServices.description: A service that allows users to connect their Solana wallets to GoDefi without sharing private keys, enabling non-custodial access to funds.
productsAndServices.name: DeFi Wallet Integration

productsAndServices.description: A protocol allowing users to lend their crypto assets to earn passive income with specified annual percentage yields (APY).
productsAndServices.name: DeFi Lending Protocol

productsAndServices.description: A service that enables users to borrow cryptocurrency funds against their assets for spending without selling them.
productsAndServices.name: Crypto Borrowing Service

productsAndServices.description: A feature enabling users to send cryptocurrency globally to contacts using their phone numbers.
productsAndServices.name: Global Crypto Transfers via Phone Number

insights.statement: The latest disclosed Seed round raised $500,000, or 33.33% of reported total funding.

insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $6,000,000 to $10,500,000, a 1.75x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
